tagline.en: Electrocatalysis · Atomically Dispersed Sites · Machine-Learning Potentials
tagline.zh: 电催化 · 原子级分散位点 · 机器学习势函数

bio.en: I am a Ph.D. candidate in Chemical Engineering at Tsinghua University. My research focuses on non-precious metal catalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), bridging experimental synthesis and characterization with density-functional theory to uncover structure–activity relationships at atomically dispersed active sites. I also develop machine-learning interatomic potentials and active-learning workflows to accelerate first-principles simulations of catalytic systems.
bio.zh: 我是清华大学化学工程系博士研究生，研究方向为面向氧还原反应（ORR）的非贵金属催化剂；通过实验合成与表征结合密度泛函理论，揭示原子级分散活性位点的构效关系。同时发展机器学习势函数与主动学习流程，用于加速催化体系的第一性原理模拟。

title.en: DFT-guided design of atomically dispersed electrocatalysts
title.zh: 原子分散电催化剂的 DFT 引导设计

description.en: Mechanistic DFT (VASP / CP2K) for single-atom and atomic-pair catalysts in ORR, CO₂RR and propylene epoxidation, in close collaboration with experimental groups: reaction pathways, free-energy diagrams, electronic-structure descriptors, and comparison with in situ spectroscopy.
description.zh: 与实验课题组紧密合作，承担单原子与双原子催化剂在 ORR、CO₂RR 及丙烯环氧化中的机理计算（VASP / CP2K）：反应路径、自由能台阶、电子结构描述符，并与原位谱学结果对照。

title.en: Machine-learning potentials for accelerated catalysis simulation
title.zh: 机器学习势函数加速催化模拟

description.en: Built an active-learning geometry-optimization loop (MLP pre-relaxation → DFT → on-the-fly fine-tuning): on a 75-atom magnetic Fe–N–C ORR catalyst, fine-tuned MACE cut DFT ionic steps from 128 to 66–73, and revealed that DPA4-Air pre-relaxation quenches the Fe spin state. Developed dataset-audit and committee active-learning protocols for MACE / DPA4 fine-tuning; MLP-driven MD of Li-ion electrolytes and molten salts.
description.zh: 搭建主动学习几何优化闭环（势函数预弛豫 → DFT → 在线微调）：在 75 原子磁性 Fe–N–C ORR 催化剂上，微调后的 MACE 将 DFT 离子步从 128 步降至 66–73 步，并发现 DPA4-Air 预弛豫会淬灭 Fe 自旋态。建立数据集审计与委员会式主动学习流程，用于 MACE / DPA4 微调；以机器学习势驱动锂离子电解液与熔盐的分子动力学。

title.en: Computational workflow and software projects
title.zh: 计算工作流与软件项目

description.en: Solid programming background. Developed an adsorbate-placement tool (particle-swarm search with rigid-ring kinematics) for generating DFT initial structures, an atomic-structure visualization tool, and an LLM-agent toolkit that automates VASP / CP2K / LAMMPS input generation, HPC submission and result verification.
description.zh: 具备扎实的代码基础。开发了吸附构型搜索工具（粒子群搜索 + 刚性环运动学，用于生成 DFT 初始结构）、原子结构可视化工具，以及面向 VASP / CP2K / LAMMPS 的 LLM 智能体工具集，覆盖输入生成、超算提交与结果核验。

title.en: Motif editing for reaction pathway switching from formate to CO in single-atom indium catalysts via adjacent carbon site manipulation
title.zh: 通过近邻碳位调控实现单原子铟催化剂的配位基元编辑与甲酸盐到 CO 的反应路径切换

highlight.en: Incorporating O into the In–N₄ Lewis interface edits the motif to In–N₂O₂, switching the CO₂RR product from formate to CO with >90% CO selectivity across −0.51 to −1.10 V vs. RHE. In situ spectroscopy and DFT reveal that In–N₂O₂ enriches the electron density of adjacent carbon sites, facilitating *COOH adsorption and CO formation.
highlight.zh: 将 O 引入 In–N₄ 的 Lewis 界面,把配位基元编辑为 In–N₂O₂,使 CO₂RR 产物由甲酸盐切换为 CO,在 −0.51 至 −1.10 V vs. RHE 电位窗口内 CO 选择性 >90%。原位光谱与 DFT 计算表明,In–N₂O₂ 提升了近邻碳位的电子密度,促进 *COOH 吸附与 CO 生成。

title.en: Efficient harvesting of electricity, aromatic aldehydes and H₂ from lignin over nanoflower-like cobalt-based bifunctional electrocatalysts
title.zh: 纳米花状钴基双功能电催化剂从木质素中高效收获电能、芳香醛与 H₂

highlight.en: Self-powered electrocatalytic system using nanoflower-like Co-catalysts for integrated lignin valorization. High-current electrodeposition on Ni foam yields a bifunctional catalyst that simultaneously harvests electricity (196.1 mW cm⁻² peak), aromatic aldehydes (2.90–3.34% yield) and H₂ (12.7 mL cm⁻²) from lignin.
highlight.zh: 构建自驱动电催化体系，利用纳米花状 Co 基催化剂实现木质素一体化增值。在泡沫镍上的大电流电沉积得到双功能催化剂，可同时从木质素中收获电能（峰值 196.1 mW cm⁻²）、芳香醛（产率 2.90–3.34%）与 H₂（12.7 mL cm⁻²）。

title.en: Internally hollow Cu₂O nanoframes with the abundance of {110} facets enhance direct propylene epoxidation
title.zh: 富含 {110} 晶面的内部中空 Cu₂O 纳米框架增强丙烯直接环氧化

highlight.en: Engineered Cu₂O nanoframes via ligand-protected facet etching achieve 0.18 mmol g_cat⁻¹ h⁻¹ PO formation rate with 83.8% selectivity at 175 °C. DFT and characterization confirm Cu₂O {110} facets promote active oxygen species generation and selective epoxidation.
highlight.zh: 通过配体保护的晶面刻蚀设计 Cu₂O 纳米框架，在 175 °C 下取得 0.18 mmol g_cat⁻¹ h⁻¹ 的 PO 生成速率与 83.8% 的选择性。DFT 计算与表征证实 Cu₂O {110} 晶面有利于活性氧物种的生成与选择性环氧化。

title.en: Circumventing radical generation on Fe-V atomic pair catalyst for robust oxygen reduction and zinc-air batteries
title.zh: Fe-V 原子对催化剂规避自由基生成实现稳健的氧还原与锌-空气电池

highlight.en: ORR pathway-switching strategy on DFT-guided Fe₁V₁-NC atomic pair catalysts circumvents ROS generation. The N₂–Fe–N₂–V–N₂ configuration enables direct O=O bond cleavage (side-on adsorption), achieving 16 mV decay over 50 k cycles, E₁/₂ = 0.89 V, and 400 h zinc-air battery durability at 10 mA cm⁻².
highlight.zh: 在 DFT 指导下的 Fe₁V₁-NC 原子对催化剂上提出 ORR 路径切换策略，规避活性氧物种（ROS）的生成。N₂–Fe–N₂–V–N₂ 构型实现 O=O 键侧位吸附与直接断裂，5 万次循环后衰减仅 16 mV，E₁/₂ = 0.89 V，在 10 mA cm⁻² 下锌-空气电池稳定运行 400 h。

title.en: Low-coordinate Cu₁–N₂ sites in single-atom catalyst for highly efficient propylene epoxidation with molecular oxygen
title.zh: 单原子催化剂中低配位 Cu₁–N₂ 位点用于分子氧高效丙烯环氧化

highlight.en: A novel Cu₁–N₂ single-atom catalyst for direct propylene epoxidation, with record PO formation rates. Characterization and DFT show exclusive Cu–N coordination enhances electrophilic oxygen species formation, enabling selective C=C bond activation.
highlight.zh: 提出新型 Cu₁–N₂ 单原子催化剂用于丙烯直接环氧化，PO 生成速率刷新纪录。表征与 DFT 表明 Cu–N 单一配位有利于亲电氧物种生成，从而实现 C=C 键的选择性活化。
